The cascade stops there: domino1, ball2, door1, pendulum1, block1, cart2, and seesaw1 remain stationary. Flap1 jitters against the shelf independently. Ball1 eventually rolls along the floor and is still moving at 20 s; ball4 remains on its shelf, not in cup1.
